_comment: race_v2 with capture doubled (1.0 -> 2.0), the one knob docs/cpc-handoff-gpu.md prescribes when K3/K4 land on "fights but does not race" (kills >= 0.3, survival >= 25 s, team_captures < 0.5). Every other term is spelled out because --reward-json merges onto RewardConfig defaults, not onto race_v2: omitting a key silently restores the v0 value (alive_per_step 0.01, hp_delta 0.01, death -1.0, team_win 1.0) instead of the zero race_v2 intends.
